info.title: Desk API
info.description: HTTP + WS gateway for the Desk personal AI assistant.

429.description: Too many attempts; see Retry-After header

post.description: Disabled by default. Operators opt in via the DESK_ENABLE_SIGNUP=1 env var; otherwise this endpoint returns 400 and the SPA hides the link. When enabled, creates a user row, bootstraps a hub workspace, sets up the per-user vault if DESK_VAULT_PASSWORD is set, and returns a session token. Rate-limited per IP (5/minute).

password.description: ≥ 12 chars; must not equal the documented seed password

429.description: Too many attempts; see Retry-After header

get.summary: Is signup enabled on this server
get.description: Lets the SPA decide whether to render the Sign-up link on the login screen without a separate config endpoint. Unauthenticated.
Returns every known provider key name with its value masked to first 6 + last 4 chars, or null when unset. Keys are stored in the user's vault, not in SQLite.

put.description: Partial update. Null value deletes a key; string value sets it. Unknown names return 400.

200.description: Updated masked keys (same shape as GET)

get.summary: List provider-key audit log entries for the current user
get.description: Returns the audit log for every read, write and delete touching the user's provider keys (AI provider API keys and connector tokens like GITHUB_TOKEN). Entries are recorded by the server, never carry the key value itself, and are scoped to the calling user. Useful as the data source for a 'recent key access' panel in account settings.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of entries to return, newest first. 1–500, default 100.

get.summary: List connector connections owned by the current user

credentials.description: Encrypted at rest and never returned by list/get responses.
Encrypted at rest and never returned by list/get responses. Null clears stored credentials.

get.description: Returns every registered local source (Codex CLI auth today; LM Studio / Ollama in the future) with its detection status and the user's per-source opt-in flag.

put.summary: Toggle a local source's per-user opt-in

delete.description: Hard-deletes the workspace row. Refuses with 400 when the caller has only one workspace — every user must retain at least one.

400.description: Cannot delete the caller's last workspace

get.summary: List connector grants for a workspace

put.summary: Replace connector grants for a workspace

get.summary: List agents enrolled in the workspace (with default flag)

post.summary: Enroll an agent in the workspace

delete.summary: Remove an agent from the workspace
Delete agent (cascades chats, messages, workspace memberships)
delete.description: Hard-deletes the agent row. `ON DELETE CASCADE` removes the agent's chats (and their messages) plus any workspace_agents rows. Chat on-disk directories are not cleaned up; revisit if agent deletion becomes user-visible in production. Refuses with 400 when the caller has only one agent — every user must retain at least one.

400.description: Cannot delete the caller's last agent

get.description: Lists chats in the given workspace. When `workspaceId` is omitted, defaults to the caller's first workspace. Returns `[]` when the user has no workspaces. 400 if `workspaceId` is malformed; 404 when it refers to a workspace the caller does not own.

200.description: Chat array with last-message snippet, persisted `goal` (`app`/`data`/`site`/etc.; explicit picker selections and clear text inference both write here), and `kind` (newest user-action message kind — `task`/`task_run`; `chat` and `summary` fall back when no goal is set).

patch.description: Patch chat metadata. `agentId` re-binds the chat to a different agent (the new agent must be enabled in the chat's workspace) — subsequent messages use the new agent's model and the user's memory.

goal.description: Persisted chat goal. Pass null to clear it.

agentId.description: Must be an agent enabled in this chat's workspace.

delete.description: Cancels any pending/recurring scheduler entries owned by the chat's messages, deletes the chat row (FK ON DELETE CASCADE drops all messages), and moves the chat's on-disk directories (`.chats/{chatId}/` hidden state and `chats/{chatId}/` attachments) to `~/Desk/.trash/`. Emits a `chat.deleted` WS event.

goal.description: Persisted chat goal for this send. Omit to keep/infer; pass null to clear the chat goal.

attachments.description: Files the user attached to this message. Each item references a file already uploaded via POST /chats/{id}/attachments — the path is workspace-relative, forward-slash separated.

patch.summary: Edit a message (title, content, cancel, reschedule)
patch.description: Update title/content (e.g. user edits a task or summary), transition state (only 'cancelled', 'paused', or 'pending' allowed), or reschedule (execute_at/cron). Emits message.updated.

delete.summary: Delete a message (cancels any scheduled firing)

get.summary: Stream a message's execution log file
get.description: Returns the accumulated stdout/stderr from an executing or completed message. Served directly from ~/Desk/desk/.chats/{chatId}/logs/{messageId}.log — no DB involvement. 404 if no log file exists yet.

get.summary: List archived versions of a summary-content message
get.description: Each PATCH of a `summary`-content message and each AI rewrite snapshots the prior body under .chats/{chatId}/notes/.history/. This endpoint returns every snapshot, newest first, and also reads legacy .chats/{chatId}/note-history/ and .chats/{chatId}/summary-history/ directories for compatibility.

Returns visible (non-dot) attachments by default. Pass ?showHidden=true to include dot-prefixed agent artifacts. Pass ?includeArtifacts=true to also include agent-written files/dirs from `.chats/{id}/artifacts/`. Each item carries a `kind` field: "attachment" or "artifact".

post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data with a single 'file' part. The part's filename and Content-Type become the attachment's name and MIME. Filenames starting with '.' are rejected (reserved for agent artifacts).

get.description: Recursively reads the workspace library directory; returns `items` (FileRef entries) and `folders` (FolderRef entries) describing the full tree. Hidden by default: dot-prefixed entries AND entries matched by any `.gitignore` in the subtree (root and nested gitignores compose like git itself). Pass `?showHidden=true` to include both. Scoped to `workspaceId`; defaults to the caller's first workspace. Returns `{items: [], folders: []}` when the user has no workspaces. 400 if `workspaceId` is malformed; 404 when it refers to a workspace the caller does not own.

post.summary: Upload a file to the workspace library
post.description: Accepts multipart/form-data with a single 'file' part and an optional 'subpath' text field naming a library-relative subdirectory (e.g. `Photos/2024`). Missing subdirectories are created recursively. Filename becomes the library entry's name; filename collisions get suffixed with -1, -2, ... Destination workspace comes from `workspaceId` (falls back to the caller's first workspace). 400 on invalid `subpath` (traversal, dotfile segments, backslashes).

subpath.description: Library-relative subdirectory to place the file in.

404.description: Workspace not found / no workspace available

patch.summary: Move or rename a library file or folder
patch.description: Renames or moves an entry within the workspace. Both `from` and `to` are workspace-root-relative paths (e.g. `Photos/2024/beach.jpg`); traversal and dot-prefixed segments are rejected. The destination must not already exist. For folders, the entire subtree moves.

404.description: Source not in workspace or not found

delete.summary: Delete a library entry (moves it to ~/Desk/.trash/)
delete.description: Works for both files and folders. Folders are recursively moved to the trash.

404.description: No such path in the resolved workspace

post.description: Creates an empty directory at the workspace-root-relative `path`. The `path` is validated against traversal, dotfile segments, and backslashes. Intermediate parents are created automatically.

get.summary: Stat a library file by workspace-relative path

404.description: No such path in the resolved workspace
No such path in the resolved workspace

get.summary: Stream a library file's bytes inline (for in-app preview)

404.description: No such path in the resolved workspace

put.summary: Save content to a library file (upsert)
put.description: Replaces the file at `path` with the request body. Creates the file and parent directories if they don't exist yet, so agent-written files (e.g. `.memory/workspace.md`) can be saved without a separate POST.

get.summary: List messages across the caller's chats
get.description: Cross-chat, read-only paginator. AND-combines the optional filters; ownership is enforced via a join on chats → workspaces so results are naturally scoped to the caller. Ordered by `createdAt DESC`, with `id DESC` as the stable tiebreaker. Response shape matches `GET /chats/{id}/messages`. Unknown `workspaceId` / `chatId` that the caller does not own → 404 (existence-hiding, same as the rest of the API).

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Restrict to chats in this workspace. Absent = all of the caller's workspaces.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Restrict to a single chat. Absent = all of the caller's chats.

parameters.name: scheduled
parameters.description: `true` = only rows with `executeAt` or `cron`; `false` = only unscheduled.

parameters.name: awaitingUser
parameters.description: `true` = the message is an agent message in state `succeeded`, the latest in its chat, and its chat's `awaitingUser` flag is set.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of `Message.kind` values (`chat|task|task_run|summary`). Distinct from `contentKind`.

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Restrict to messages whose `parent_id` matches. Combined with `kind=task_run`, returns a task's run history.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only messages with `createdAt > since`. Useful for WS-reconnect catchup.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `nextCursor` in the previous page.

200.description: Paginated message array; same shape as `GET /chats/{id}/messages`.

400.description: Invalid query parameter (malformed id, unknown state, etc.)

404.description: Explicit `workspaceId` or `chatId` is not owned by the caller

get.summary: List AI models that are ready to use
get.description: Returns the set of models available in the sandbox. Free opencode models (e.g. opencode/big-pickle) are always present. Paid-provider models appear only when the user has configured the matching API key via /me/providers. Foundation of host-initiated sandboxed tool calling (ARCHITECTURE.md §7).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Restrict to a single provider id, e.g. "opencode".

503.description: No container runtime is available to query the sandbox

get.summary: Search across artifacts, chats, and library

200.description: Search result array. Chat results are indexed message or summary hits from chat_search_index.

get.description: Upgrades to WebSocket. Authenticate via ?token= query parameter.

post.description: Fires a pending scheduled message by id. Invoked by at/cron via curl. Loopback + shared-secret required. Idempotent — concurrent fires on the same messageId converge on one execution via a pending→running state transition.
